title: The Gaze of the Cosmic Eye
next_chapter_hook: The voice came from antiquity: 'You have finally reached this point, the Seventh Chess Player.'

text.content: In the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, the night was as dark as ink. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a blue stone, spiritual energy flowing around him like water, yet in the darkness it was drawing lines invisible to others—these were the chess game he had set, silently converging toward the vital pivot where the three great sects intersected. The waning moon hid behind clouds. The wind ceased. His fingers paused slightly, the seventh point of the chess game had just been locked, but in the next moment—the Tianji Record shuddered violently.

It was an indescribable tremor, not coming from outside, but seeping through the cracks between heaven and earth itself. The golden cover of the Tianji Record opened on its own, and the wisp of Mo Xiansheng's soul shadow twisted violently within, as if encountering some indescribable suppression. 'Be... careful...' Mo Xiansheng's voice shattered into fragments, as if forcibly torn apart by some force. Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, his fingers rapidly forming seals as he forcibly suppressed the Tianji Record's aura, but that tremor only grew more intense instead of weakening—something was ascending against the current along this thread of aura.

dialogue.content: Impossible. The Tianji Record's aura was concealed by Demonic Path mist—even Heavenly Dao Will should not be able to track it—Unless... His pupils contracted sharply. Unless that thing already knew where he was.

text.content: At this moment, the Void cracked open. Not from his出手, not from any attack, but from the River of Destiny that the Tianji Record had once gazed upon—silently breaking apart in the middle. Chen Ji looked up. He saw it. Above that fractured River of Destiny, in the dimension beyond Heavenly Dao, an eye... was slowly opening.

It was not an eye. Or rather, it was the origin of all eyes—the source of all gazes, insights, and foresight. It had no distinction between sclera and pupil, only endless depth and endless coldness, as if the entire will of the universe had been compressed into that single pupil. Chen Ji felt as if he had been pinned to the spot. Not from fear, but because—his divine soul, at this moment, had been completely locked onto by that eye.

dialogue.content: 'You see me.' The voice did not come from that eye, but resounded directly in his Mental Sea—ancient, majestic, without a trace of emotion. 'Seventh Chess Player.'

text.content: Chen Ji's Mental Sea violently surged. It was not an ordinary soul impact, but a crushing confirmation of existence—as if all his disguises, all his schemes, all his carefully woven chess games had become transparent before that eye. His Heavenly Fate Value plummeted. Five points, ten points, fifteen points... with each deepening gaze from that eye, his Heavenly Fate Value dissipated like flowing water.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, forcing his divine sense not to scatter under that oppressive might. He quickly calculated in his heart: his Heavenly Fate Value had fallen from the peak of 120 points to less than 60. If he continued to be gazed upon like this, it wouldn't be long before he—But the corner of his mouth slightly curved upward in this desperate situation. Interesting.

text.content: Because he had noticed several key details. First, although that eye was incomprehensibly powerful, it had not directly struck to erase him—this meant it was bound by some rule. Second, it called him 'Chess Player'—this meant he was not its only piece, it still needed him to complete some mission. Third, and most crucially—It was using 'gaze,' not 'erasure.' This proved that, at this moment, all it could do was gaze.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up. His movements were slow, yet carried a sense of resolution—under that gaze beyond Heavenly Dao, an ordinary person would have their divine soul collapse just from enduring that pressure, yet not only did he stand firm, he was even tidying his sleeves. He raised his head and looked directly into that bottomless eye.

text.content: In the Mental Sea, Chen Ji's voice was as calm as if discussing today's weather: 'Since Elder has been watching for so long, surely Elder has seen enough by now.' His tone held not a trace of fear, but carried a subtle, almost teasing quality. 'It's just that the junior is somewhat curious—why would an existence like Elder personally gaze upon a 'waste'? Could it be... that Elder's chess game has also reached its critical endgame?'

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Dao Eye's gaze and pressure, Chen Ji needed to make a choice in an extremely short time—every point of his Heavenly Fate Value was draining away, and that existence beyond Heavenly Dao was awaiting his response.

choices.description: Conceal all edge, present a weak persona to reduce this eye's interest, temporarily preserve Heavenly Fate Value and schemes.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, maintain mystery, avoid premature exposure
choices.risk_hint: May continue to be locked, and the other party may consider him merely an ordinary chess piece

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, compressing his aura to near nothingness. He let his divine soul fall into a state of feigned death and silence—just like he had done for the past ten years as a servant in Tianqing Sect, ordinary, dim,，毫无threatening. The eye's gaze lingered on him for a moment. Then, it began to shift. 'Waste... is it?' The voice carried an elusive meaning, then receded like a tide.

choices.description: Counter the gaze using the Tianji Record Fragment's power, respond as a Chess Player, display true spirit and trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value -30 (cost of forcibly resisting Heavenly Dao Will)
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key truth fragments about the Heavenly Dao Eye, temporarily break the lock
choices.risk_hint: Massive Heavenly Fate Value consumption; if failed, may cause severe divine soul damage
choices.process_label: summon Celestial Secrets Record, confront head-on

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. The Tianji Record Fragment emerged from his Brow Center, golden light colliding violently with that eye's gaze—'You dare...' For the first time, that voice fluctuated, as if touched by something beyond its expectations. Chen Ji saw it—in that golden light, something... shattered.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to create a 'substitute chess game,' making the Heavenly Dao Eye believe he is merely an abandoned piece, turning its attention to the true target.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes one instance of the Tianji Record Fragment's foresight ability
choices.visible_reward: Completely redirect the Heavenly Dao Eye's attention, buy time for subsequent schemes
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will completely enrage the Heavenly Dao Eye, with dire consequences
choices.process_label: weave decoy chess game, sneak through

text.content: Chen Ji's thoughts raced at lightning speed. He drew a thread of foresight power from the Tianji Record, weaving a brand new 'chess game' upon his own fate trajectory—a piece that appeared similar to him but was actually meaningless. That eye was indeed drawn to it. 'So that's how it is...' Its attention shifted away from him, falling upon that false chess piece. Chen Ji's back was already soaked with cold sweat.

Three choices, three distinctly different fate branches. No matter which path Chen Ji chose, that eye's gaze had not completely faded—it hung like a sword above his head, ready to fall at any moment. But at least, in this moment, he had bought himself breathing room. And that eye... seemed to be waiting for something.

At this very moment, something was gathering in the depths of that eye. It was not pressure, not will, but a piece of... information. Chen Ji subconsciously operated the Tianji Record, attempting to capture this information's essence—then his pupils contracted sharply. It was a scene. Blurred, fragmented, broken apart by Heavenly Fate Lock—

In the scene, a woman's figure loomed faintly. She was imprisoned by chains in endless darkness, surrounded by countless golden runes—a seal, powerful enough that even the Tianji Record could not fully peer through. But her face... Chen Ji's heart was grasped by an invisible hand, tightening abruptly. It was his sister who had been missing for years—Chen Nian.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's breath stopped at that moment. His hands unconsciously clenched tightly, fingernails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers, yet he was completely unaware. Chen Nian... That sister he had sworn to find was now imprisoned in an abyss beyond his reach. And that eye was transmitting this scene... to him. This was a threat. This was a temptation. This was—the beginning of the chess game.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's figure appeared in the scene forcibly projected by the Heavenly Dao Eye—is this a threat or an invitation? Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Regardless of cost, forcibly capture the complete information of this scene, attempting to see Chen Nian's imprisonment location and captors.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value -20 (cost of forcibly gazing)
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues about Chen Nian's location
choices.risk_hint: May deplete the last of Heavenly Fate Value, causing divine soul collapse

dialogue.content: Chen Ji bit the tip of his tongue, propelling the Tianji Record with his essence blood. Heavenly Fate Value poured out like a breached dam, his divine soul trembling in agony—but he saw it clearly. Above that darkness, an ancient bronze mirror hung, with a character carved in the center of its surface— 'Mirror.' This was the Mirror Sect.

choices.description: Forcefully suppress the surging emotions in his heart, do not be deceived by the Heavenly Dao Eye's trap, first analyze this scene's source and purpose.
choices.visible_reward: May see through the Heavenly Dao Eye's intentions, provide information advantage for subsequent schemes
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best opportunity to obtain Chen Nian's information

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly pressing the surging emotions into the deepest part of his heart. Calm. He told himself. This scene came too conveniently, just at the critical moment of his scheme, just when his location was exposed—this was a probe. The Heavenly Dao Eye wanted to see his reaction, wanted to know his weakness. And he... simply would not give it what it wanted.

choices.description: No longer passively endure, but proactively speak, attempting to establish some connection with the Heavenly Dao Eye, probing its true purpose.
choices.visible_cost: Unknown (depends on the other party's response)
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key information about the Heavenly Dao Eye's nature
choices.risk_hint: Proactively expose oneself, may invite more intense suppression

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled. 'Elder specially allowed the junior to see this, surely not merely to warn?' He raised his head, his gaze staring directly into that bottomless eye. 'The junior dares to guess—what does Elder need the junior to do?' That eye fell silent. It was silent for a very long time.

text.content: After the prolonged silence, a ripple finally emerged in the depths of that eye. 'Interesting.' The voice rang out for the third time, but this time carried a hint of... amusement. 'You are different from them all.' Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat. 'Them'? Could there have been other 'Chess Players' before him?

'Six Chess Players, some died from Heavenly Fate backlash, some died from Heavenly Dao liquidation, some died from... their own unwillingness.' The voice calmly stated, as if narrating six stories that had long concluded. 'You are the Seventh.' 'And the only one... who could still open his mouth to speak when直视本座.' Chen Ji did not speak. He was waiting. 'Interesting. So this seat has decided—to give you an opportunity.'

That eye's pupil slightly contracted, a golden thread shooting out from within and entering Chen Ji's Mental Sea. In an instant, he saw—an ancient mirror called 'Mirror,' suspended in some forbidden land beyond the three great sects. That was where the Mirror Sect was located. And also where Chen Nian was imprisoned. 'Go and obtain it.' The voice came from antiquity, carrying irresistible might: 'You have finally reached this point, the Seventh Chess Player.'
